# scylladbcloud_account_certificate (Data Source)

The account's CA certificate, used to verify TLS connections to its clusters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_account_certificate" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The certificate.
- `format` (String) Certificate format, e.g. PEM.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
